package rulefixtures

import (
	"time"
)

// scenario for time_tick_per_call: `time.Tick(...)` on regular call paths instead of owning a reusable ticker.
// fixture polarity: positive; family: performance; severity: info.
func scenario686Positive(items []string) int {
	total := 0
	for _, item := range items {
		ch := time.Tick(100 * time.Millisecond)
		select {
		case <-ch:
			total += len(item)
		default:
		}
	}
	return total
}
